general.description: Kikowaena minigame e hoʻomohala ʻia ana

section1.title: Aloha e SakuraLands!
content: E pāʻani pū me nā hoaaloha mai nā wahi like ʻole o ka honua.
E hui pū i nā minigames nui, nā huakaʻi, a me nā mea hou aku!

section2.title: Nui nā ʻōlelo!
content: Aloha mai nā mea pāʻani mai nā wahi a puni o ka honua.
Kākoʻo ko mākou kaiāulu i nā ʻōlelo he nui, no laila e loaʻa mau ana nā hoa e pāʻani pū ai.
section2.warning: * Ua unuhi ʻia kekahi mau huaʻōlelo e nā mīkini, no laila ʻaʻole pololei paha.

section3.title: Nui nā Minigames!
content: E ʻoliʻoli i nā minigames like ʻole: parkour, skywars, bedwars, escape maze, a me nā mea hou aku.
Aia nō kekahi mea hou e hoʻāʻo ai!

section4.title: Palekana!
content: Mālama mākou i ka pāʻani kūpono a me ka malu o nā mea pāʻani.
Hōʻoia ko mākou poʻe limahana lokomaikaʻi i ka palekana a me ka leʻaleʻa o kāu ʻike.

section5.title: E Pāʻani i kēia manawa!
section5.content: E komo i ke kikowaena i kēia lā.
